patch:
@@ -1271,10 +1271,46 @@ if(STRATA_NATIVE_EXPERTS)
         list(APPEND _strata_mmq_cuda_types q6_k)    #   and gfx906: moe_mmq.cu calls it under __HIPCC__
       endif()
     endif()
+    # In-place experts (prefill.cpp, gu_inplace): MMQ reads x as a table of expert pointers when the expert stride is
+    # negative.  A copy of the pinned mmq.cuh with that change goes into the build tree, with the instance files
+    # compiled against it (their "../mmq.cuh" finds the copy); the checkout itself is not touched.  Each replaced
+    # text must occur exactly 3 times (the three tile loops), or the configure stops.
+    set(_strata_mmqp ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/strata_mmq_patched)
+    file(READ ${_strata_mmq}/mmq.cuh _mmq_src)
+    set(_mmq_out "${_mmq_src}")
+    set(_mmq_from1 "const int offset_x = fastdiv(wt, sample_ratio)*stride_sample_x + fastdiv(zt, channel_ratio)*stride_channel_x + it*I*stride_row_x;")
+    set(_mmq_to1 "const char * x_tile = stride_channel_x < 0 ? ((const char * const *) x)[fastdiv(zt, channel_ratio)] : x; const int offset_x = fastdiv(wt, sample_ratio)*stride_sample_x + (stride_channel_x < 0 ? 0 : fastdiv(zt, channel_ratio)*stride_channel_x) + it*I*stride_row_x;")
+    set(_mmq_from2 "(x, offset_x, y + offset_y,")
+    set(_mmq_to2 "(x_tile, offset_x, y + offset_y,")
+    foreach(_k 1 2)
+      string(LENGTH "${_mmq_out}" _l0)
+      string(REPLACE "${_mmq_from${_k}}" "${_mmq_to${_k}}" _mmq_out "${_mmq_out}")
+      string(LENGTH "${_mmq_out}" _l1)
+      string(LENGTH "${_mmq_from${_k}}" _lf)
+      string(LENGTH "${_mmq_to${_k}}" _lt)
+      math(EXPR _n "(${_l1} - ${_l0}) / (${_lt} - ${_lf})")
+      if(NOT _n EQUAL 3)
+        message(FATAL_ERROR "strata: ${_strata_mmq}/mmq.cuh: the in-place patch text ${_k} occurs ${_n} times, not 3 "
+                            "(a different llama.cpp than the pinned one?)")
+      endif()
+    endforeach()
+    file(WRITE ${_strata_mmqp}/mmq.cuh "${_mmq_out}\n#define STRATA_MMQ_X_PTRS 1\n")
+    # the headers that include "mmq.cuh" next to themselves, copied unchanged so that include finds the patched copy
+    file(GLOB _mmq_users RELATIVE ${_strata_mmq} ${_strata_mmq}/*.cuh)
+    foreach(_h IN LISTS _mmq_users)
+      file(READ ${_strata_mmq}/${_h} _mmq_h)
+      string(FIND "${_mmq_h}" "#include \"mmq.cuh\"" _at)
+      if(NOT _at EQUAL -1 AND NOT _h STREQUAL "mmq.cuh")
+        file(WRITE ${_strata_mmqp}/${_h} "${_mmq_h}")
+      endif()
+    endforeach()
     foreach(_t IN LISTS _strata_mmq_cuda_types)
-      target_sources(strata_mmq PRIVATE ${_strata_mmq}/template-instances/mmq-instance-${_t}.cu)
+      file(READ ${_strata_mmq}/template-instances/mmq-instance-${_t}.cu _mmq_inst)
+      file(WRITE ${_strata_mmqp}/template-instances/mmq-instance-${_t}.cu "${_mmq_inst}")
+      target_sources(strata_mmq PRIVATE ${_strata_mmqp}/template-instances/mmq-instance-${_t}.cu)
     endforeach()
-    target_include_directories(strata_mmq PRIVATE ${_strata_gg}/include ${_strata_gg}/src ${_strata_mmq}
+    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${_strata_mmq}/mmq.cuh)
+    target_include_directories(strata_mmq PRIVATE ${_strata_mmqp} ${_strata_gg}/include ${_strata_gg}/src ${_strata_mmq}
                                PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
     target_compile_options(strata_mmq PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:--extended-lambda -use_fast_math>)
     if(MSVC)
